name: rider-layout
description: Applies JetBrains Rider-compatible C# file and type layout patterns in VS Code.

commands.title: Rider Layout: Reset to Default Layout
Rider Layout: Toggle Format on Save
Rider Layout: Rearrange All C# Files

riderLayout.autoApplyOnFocus.description: Automatically apply the active Rider layout whenever a C# file gains focus.

riderLayout.formatAfterRearrange.description: Format the document (Shift+Alt+F) after the layout is applied.

riderLayout.ignoreFolders.markdownDescription: Folder names (by name, at any depth) to skip in **Rearrange All C# Files**. `Migrations` is included by default. Add more with the file picker: [Add Ignored Folder…](command:riderLayout.addIgnoreFolder)

riderLayout.settingsPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Rider/ReSharper layout file (`.xml` or `.DotSettings`). Leave empty to use the bundled **ideen-layout.xml** default. Open the file browser to store a custom path (saved globally): [Select Layout File…](command:riderLayout.pickLayoutFile). Go back to the bundled default: [Reset to Default](command:riderLayout.resetLayout). You can also type/paste a path directly here.

riderLayout.emitRegions.description: Master switch for emitting section region blocks. Toggle with the 'Rider Layout: Toggle Region Blocks' command without losing your region selection.

riderLayout.regions.description: Which <Region Name> values from the layout XML to emit as #region blocks. All are enabled by default; deselect entries to omit specific regions from the output.
